patterns: What's the location of Eastern Mennonite University?
responses: EMU is located in Harrisonburg, Virginia. The full address is 1200 Park Road, Harrisonburg, VA 22802.
You’ll find EMU in the Shenandoah Valley of Virginia at 1200 Park Rd, Harrisonburg.

patterns: How do I get to EMU?
What's the best way to reach EMU?
How do you get to the campus?
responses: You can drive to EMU or fly into Shenandoah Valley Regional Airport (SHD), which is about 25 minutes away. Dulles (IAD) and Charlottesville (CHO) airports are also options.
Driving is the most common way. Just enter 1200 Park Rd, Harrisonburg, VA into your GPS.

patterns: How do I schedule a visit?
I want to see the EMU campus
How do I plan a tour?
responses: Yes, EMU offers campus tours! You can schedule a visit at [emu.edu/visit](https://emu.edu/visit).
Campus visits and tours can be arranged through EMU’s admissions page. Check out available dates and times online.

patterns: How do I find the library?
How do I get to the gym?
Can you give directions on campus?
responses: You can use EMU’s campus map to find buildings and offices: [emu.edu/map](https://emu.edu/map).
The campus map and signage make it easy to navigate. Stop by the welcome desk for help if you're lost!

patterns: Are there places to eat close by?
responses: EMU is near downtown Harrisonburg with lots of restaurants, coffee shops, and stores just a short drive or walk away.
You’ll find groceries, cafes, and dining options on Route 42 and in downtown Harrisonburg.

patterns: Do visitors need a parking pass?
How does parking work at EMU?
responses: Yes, there is parking on campus. Visitors can get a temporary parking pass from the welcome center or admissions office.
Students, faculty, and staff need a parking permit. Visitors should check in for a guest pass.
